Do you remember the feeling of backing your car out of the driveway for the very first time? That sensation is pure freedom. But for your parents, that moment might be one of the most terrifying of their lives. When you were a teenager, they had absolutely no way of knowing whether you were speeding, where you had gone, when you would arrive, or how safely you were driving. "No news is good news" — they could only hope everything was fine until you checked in.

If you currently have a teenager who drives, you should really cherish it, because you are no longer in the era of having to worry about those kinds of moments. Although 2026 technology has its imperfections, HeyPolo is clearly a fine example of how technology can make teen driving safer and life better.

HeyPolo is more than just an upgraded version of Apple's Find My service

HeyPolo is a family safety app that bundles real-time location sharing, arrival and departure notifications, SOS emergency alerts, and driving safety features all into one price. The driving feature is what sets it apart most from ordinary location-sharing apps (such as Find My). Every time your child gets behind the wheel, their driving behaviour is tracked and scored, so you can clearly see how they are performing: how fast they drive, whether they use their phone while driving, whether there is any harsh braking or sudden acceleration, and whether any serious driving events are detected.

The "Driving Score" rates every trip based on their actual driving behaviour, so you no longer have to guess whether your child is really driving safely. You can look at the data, and if their driving performance is poor, have a serious talk with them, so that their driving habits improve and the score gradually rises. Compared to anything the previous generation could get their hands on, this is far more useful for helping newly licensed drivers build their skills.

Collision detection, arrival notifications, and more

HeyPolo can detect a collision and automatically notify you. Add in arrival alerts — whether your child has made it to school, the practice field, a friend's house, or home, the system will send a triggered notification — and you can go from "hoping no news is good news" to actually knowing whether they are safe. You don't have to wait until they have arrived before messaging or calling them; you can know exactly when they have arrived, and that peace of mind is priceless for parents. HeyPolo updates the location every 5 seconds, so your location information is always accurate.

One price, shared by the whole family

A single HeyPolo subscription already covers your entire family, with absolutely no extra per-person fees. It also supports both iPhone and Android, so households mixing and matching different devices need not worry about that. HeyPolo is developed by the team behind Surfshark, so it has a solid privacy foundation. They will not sell your data; you control what you share, with whom, and when to stop sharing, and all data is automatically deleted every 7 days. For a location-based app, this is absolutely essential on the privacy front.

HeyPolo comes with a 30-day money-back guarantee and no contract required — there is absolutely no reason not to give it a try.
